title: Aether Reliquary visual direction
summary: The approved production target is high-fidelity illustrated 2D browser RPG art: painted or rendered characters, outfits, weapons, armor, enemies, locations, and VFX with material depth and readable silhouettes.

approvedStyleTarget.label: Hero Kit quality target
approvedStyleTarget.description: Mario approved the current Hero Kit character, outfit, weapon, and armor quality as the baseline. New visual assets should match this richer painted/rendered look instead of flat vector glyphs.

nextProductionBatches.label: Enemy and boss high-fidelity cards
nextProductionBatches.acceptance: Enemies should look like actual painted/rendered RPG monsters with bodies, materials, readable threats, and codex-card presence.

nextProductionBatches.label: Bellroot prologue high-fidelity story pack
nextProductionBatches.acceptance: The prologue replacement pack must feel like game story art, not UI symbols.

nextProductionBatches.label: Weapon quality variant cards
nextProductionBatches.acceptance: Quality should read through material, finish, glow, and silhouette changes without requiring separate art for every item.

nextProductionBatches.label: City and region high-fidelity cards
nextProductionBatches.acceptance: Each city card needs a distinct RPG travel identity with environment depth and faction flavor.

promptStyleRules: Use high-fidelity illustrated 2D browser RPG art, painted or rendered, with material depth.
Keep characters and gear readable at small UI/card sizes.
Use warm ancient techno-fantasy materials: brass, leather, ash, glass, nacre, stone, root, cloth, and ember light.
Avoid flat vector glyphs, UI icons, logos, text, modern firearms, sci-fi guns, and franchise-derived silhouettes.
Use the Hero Kit sheets as the quality reference before approving any new batch.
